name: HKDFExtract
description: Performs the Extract phase of HKDF to create a Pseudo-Random Key (PRK). Use with HKDFExpand to derive multiple keys.
syntax: HKDFExtract( string algorithm, any salt, any inputKeyMaterial )

params.name: algorithm
params.description: Hash algorithm: SHA256, SHA384, or SHA512

params.name: salt
params.description: Salt value (can be empty string or null)
